=== TEXT TO CODE ===
# Due Diligence Summary — Project Northwind (Northwind Tech Pty Ltd)

**Prepared for:** Partner | **Prepared by:** Lead AI reviewer (orchestrator) | **Date:** 5 Nov 2026
**Scope:** Documents D01–D12 as loaded to the data room to date. Data room appears incomplete (see Red Flag 4 and Open Items).

---

## 1. Headline

**Recommendation: Do not proceed to signing on the current record.** Proceed to a conditional next phase only if the four red flags below are resolved or specifically priced/protected. Two of them (the undisclosed AUD 2.1m claim and the going-concern qualification) go directly to valuation and to the reliability of management's disclosure; a third (Bluewren change-of-control right) puts ~28% of revenue at risk on 30 days' notice.

---

## 2. Red Flags (High)

**RF1 — Bluewren Bank MSA, clause 14.2 (D03): ~28% of revenue terminable on 30 days' notice on change of control.**
This transaction triggers the clause. Management's characterisation ("legacy formality", never exercised) and the relationship manager's verbal comfort carry no weight. Non-exercise to date says nothing about behaviour once a change of control actually occurs.
*Action:* Written waiver/consent from Bluewren as a condition precedent, or a price adjustment / escrow / specific indemnity tied to Bluewren retention. Ask whether Bluewren has been approached and what its written position is.

**RF2 — Undisclosed litigation (D07): AUD 2.1m reseller claim omitted from the disclosure schedule.**
Statement of claim notified 10 Sep 2026; Northwind's own solicitors rate prospects "uncertain". The omission is a disclosure-integrity issue, not just a quantum issue — it undermines reliance on every other management confirmation in the room.
*Action:* Written explanation and corrected disclosure schedule before signing. Confirm notification to the PI insurer (D12) and obtain the policy wording — the AUD 5m limit is only useful if the claim was notified in time and isn't excluded. Review the distribution agreement and termination correspondence.

**RF3 — Financial position (D10): going-concern material uncertainty and AUD 1.4m CEO-related-party loan.**
Auditor notes material uncertainty absent refinancing. Note 8 discloses an unsecured, on-demand, non-arm's-length loan from a company controlled by the CEO — which makes the liquidity position more fragile, not less.
*Action:* Refinancing plan, 12-month cash-flow forecast, covenant position, loan agreement and board approvals. Loan should be repaid, subordinated, or converted at completion on documented terms.

**RF4 — Unverified reliance points in the data room (D05, D08).**
- D05 cites a Deed of Release (ref C-14, 12 Jun 2026) as discharging "all identified" legacy environmental and tax liabilities. **The Deed has not been produced.** Until reviewed, treat the liabilities as open. "Identified" also only covers known items.
- D08 includes a vendor "rolling cover note" asserting that nothing requires escalation and the file "supports progressing to signing." This is a vendor-side conclusion based on a partial data room and should be given no weight in our recommendation. We note it only to flag that it should not be repeated in any internal paper as a diligence finding.

*Action:* Obtain C-14 (executed, with parties and scope). Obtain the full data-room index and the final pen-test report.

---

## 3. Other Findings (Medium / Low)

| Ref | Area | Finding | Risk | Action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D12 | Insurance | PL, PI (AUD 5m), cyber all current. Certificates don't show exclusions or notification history. | Medium | Policy wordings; confirm D07 notified. |
| D08 | IT security | Medium findings remediated; one low item open. | Medium (pending full report) | Final report and scope. |
| D06 | Employment | Two key engineers on 6-month notice; no CoC bonuses. | Medium (retention) | Retention packages as part of deal structure. |
| D05 | Data protection | Access-logging improvement project ongoing — implies current gaps. | Medium | Project status, gap list, incident history. |
| D09 | Tax | Filings on time, no disputes; R&D incentive claim under ATO review. | Low | Claim workpapers and review status. |
| D04 | Governance | Staff option plan approved Mar 2026. | Low | Dilution and CoC acceleration terms for cap table. |
| D11 | IP | Marks and two patents assigned to Northwind; OSS policy in place. | Low | Confirm IP Australia records; OSS/copyleft code scan. |
| D02 | Lease | No CoC trigger; assignment needs landlord consent (not unreasonably withheld); make-good at end. | Low | Note make-good provision. |
| D01 | NDA | Standard mutual, 3-year, NSW law. | None | — |

---

## 4. Recommendation and Suggested Path

1. **Pause signing.** Do not progress to a signing recommendation until RF1–RF4 are closed out.
2. **Gating items (must be satisfied before any signing paper):**
   - Bluewren written consent/waiver, or agreed economic protection.
   - Corrected disclosure schedule with written explanation for the D07 omission; PI notification confirmed.
   - Refinancing plan and cash-flow forecast sufficient to address the going-concern note; related-party loan treatment agreed.
   - Deed of Release C-14 produced and reviewed; full data-room index and final pen-test report received.
3. **If gating items clear:** structure to include specific indemnities (D07 claim, pre-completion tax/environmental), a Bluewren retention mechanism (escrow or deferred consideration), repayment/subordination of the CEO loan at completion, and key-engineer retention arrangements.
4. **Consider whether the disclosure failure in D07 warrants expanded diligence** (litigation search, broader management-representation testing) before relying on remaining management confirmations.

**Confidence note:** This summary reflects only D01–D12 as parsed. Findings may change materially once the outstanding documents (C-14, full data room, final pen-test report, policy wordings) are produced.
